source:
Follow [docs/DEVELOPMENT-STORAGE.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT-STORAGE.md). Preserve
required development inputs and evidence for recovery on another computer.

Owner ruling 2026-09-14: cumulative stopwatch budgets are not approval or
execution gates for ordinary focused deterministic verification in the current
v12 delivery/v13 development campaign. This supersedes earlier cumulative
author/reviewer caps, remaining-bank admission checks and demands to reconstruct
missing historical seconds before another ordinary test iteration, including
W161230's prospective1200s grant in M166281. No replenishment request is needed
solely because a cumulative test allowance is exhausted or historically unknown.

current_rule: Focused cumulative seconds not a gate; sensible per-run limits, truthful durations, investigate resource uncertainty; scope unchanged.
source:
Use sensible per-run timeouts appropriate to the Job and test, with process
termination and cleanup time. Predictions guide planning; they are not exact
evidence or additional approval gates. Record measured durations when available,
mark unknowns and estimates honestly, and preserve existing evidence. Do not
manufacture upper bounds or erase costs. An unproved historical total is not
proof that old processes ended; investigate concrete resource uncertainty
separately without turning missing seconds into a development blocker.

current_rule: Focused cumulative seconds not a gate; sensible per-run limits, truthful durations, investigate resource uncertainty; scope unchanged.

a previously excluded run or rerun, remove a reviewed single-run supervisor's
limits, or change product Job timeout semantics. No broad discovery merely to
settle historical accounting. Exact decision and correction:

a change was handed off, or a fresh run identity was prepared. Reuse applicable

current_rule: Custody modes not checkout modes; non-symlink regular/base/owner-writable preflight; entire refusal before mutation; ops repair; final modes.
source:
- Custody file modes protect immutable evidence and are never checkout mode
  instructions. Before any import, `baton.merge` requires every existing target
  to be a non-symlink regular file matching the reviewed base bytes and already
  owner-writable. A failed type, byte, or owner-write check refuses the whole
  import before content or mode mutation and returns it to `baton.ops` for exact
  repair. The integrator imports reviewed content without preserving custody
  modes and must verify final bytes and modes. It must never work around a
  read-only target with `install`, `chmod`, or another privileged replacement. An
  explicitly planned new regular file uses ordinary non-executable repository
  mode; executable mode requires explicit accepted scope.

current_rule: One readiness path, act immediately, wait read-only, obligations/acknowledgments, rearm and no unattended completion.

  to answer a directed `@` obligation, `mark-seen` to acknowledge messages.
  Re-arm `wait` after every result. Never leave a successful readiness result
  unattended; terminal completion may not itself schedule a new model turn.

current_rule: Direct development selected, no orchestration packet gate; no extra live/install/claim/Git authority, safe transitions.
source:
Until explicitly superseded, do not use v12 orchestration for routine v12
development. Implement, correct and verify directly through the existing agent
workflow under the current v11 claim protocol. A v12 Job, bespoke launch packet
or additional host-execution exception is not required for ordinary authorized
development. This supersedes the October 18 mandatory v12 execution and
no-direct-fallback rules, including older Work wording that repeats them.

current_rule: Direct development selected, no orchestration packet gate; no extra live/install/claim/Git authority, safe transitions.
source:
Preserve accepted scope, file ownership, isolated candidates where needed for
overlap/provenance, independent exact-byte review, deterministic verification
defaults, required acceptance and human Git ownership. Reuse retained work and
focused evidence. Tests of actual v12 orchestration still exercise that product
boundary when needed; existing live-provider, engine and deployment selection
boundaries remain. No new live run, install, deployment, claim takeover or Git
mutation is authorized by this development-workflow ruling.

boundary. V11 remains the coordination authority until an explicit cutoff;

Decision: [temporary direct workflow](work/records/2026/10/finding-v12-development-coordination-pilot/FINDING.md#2026-10-22--suspend-mandatory-v12-development-orchestration).

source: ## V12 test execution policy — owner 2026-10-30

current_rule: Mandatory TESTING guide, groups/prepared interpreter, selected full run, exact required accounting and registries; transient evidence stays dossier.
source:
Owner ruling (W384870, T384870 M384887): a durable guide to running the v12
Python tests exists at `v12/python/TESTING.md`, and following it is critical.
Every agent doing v12 test work (writing, repairing, selecting or reporting
tests) reads and follows that guide. Concretely:

current_rule: Mandatory TESTING guide, groups/prepared interpreter, selected full run, exact required accounting and registries; transient evidence stays dossier.
source:
- Declare the affected logical groups (the guide's nine) in the handoff and
  verify with `just test-one` / `just test-group GROUP` from `v12/python` by
  default; focused verification is the normal cadence.

current_rule: Mandatory TESTING guide, groups/prepared interpreter, selected full run, exact required accounting and registries; transient evidence stays dossier.
source:
- A full `just test-all LOG` is an integration checkpoint that the owning Work
  explicitly selects; do not run one routinely, and a retry after a fix is a
  new selected checkpoint, not an automatic rerun.

current_rule: Mandatory TESTING guide, groups/prepared interpreter, selected full run, exact required accounting and registries; transient evidence stays dossier.
source: - Use the prepared interpreter the recipes resolve; never the ambient one.

current_rule: Mandatory TESTING guide, groups/prepared interpreter, selected full run, exact required accounting and registries; transient evidence stays dossier.
source:
- Every test is required unless its exact id is in the runner's
  `OPTIONAL_SKIPS` with a recorded owner ruling; a skip outside that registry,
  a class fixture that skips or errors, or a never-started test fails an
  accounted run and is reported, never waived.

current_rule: Mandatory TESTING guide, groups/prepared interpreter, selected full run, exact required accounting and registries; transient evidence stays dossier.
source:
- New test modules go into exactly one execution registry and one group; a
  module that binds another module's test classes is refused.

current_rule: Mandatory TESTING guide, groups/prepared interpreter, selected full run, exact required accounting and registries; transient evidence stays dossier.
source:
- Retain the log, the JSON ledger and the source identity header together as
  evidence; a passed count without its collected count is not evidence.
